gap: These are REASONS, not priced actions. A mentor types a number today, so two mentors award different points for the same deed and the rank table above them means different things for different members. The official priced catalogue has not been supplied.

actions.label: Living the values
actions.note: A value demonstrated plainly enough that a mentor can name what was seen.

actions.label: Leadership
actions.note: Carried a group, a session or a decision.

actions.label: Service to others
actions.note: Gave time, skill or presence to somebody else’s problem.

actions.label: Excellent work
actions.note: Work finished to a standard above what was asked.

actions.label: Growth
actions.note: Measurable change in the member themselves.

actions.label: Mentorship
actions.note: Mentoring — and in particular a mentee rising to the next rank.

actions.label: Other
actions.note: Anything else. The proposal must say why.
